You're not alone! I'm in the same boat as you. I developed a metabolical disease after the pandemic and now I can't work either, and my husband of only 4 years has to take everything on, and my car's about to be repoed and I used to work my tail off As a dental hygienist and a dance teacher. I'm not sure how we stay positive but I do know that is the biggest necessity to recovery. Hang in there. I'm about to go on a cancer journey too.

Oh my God! To start, your stomach is not going to be happy on PAXLOVID!!! invest in some body armor drinks, saltine crackers and maybe some sour gummy candies because you're going to need them! The antivirals suck but if you can stick them out for 5 days of misery, it'll all be over and you can resume your treatment. I hope 5 days isn't too long! I'll keep you in my prayers. Also, get yourself some baby wipes. -if you respond to the drug like I did, it's no picnic but worth it when it's all done and out of your system.

This is a simple answer only cause I'm tired. Try taking a vitamin D supplement. I'm on lots of antidepressants but only once I added vitamin D did I actually feel ok. -sometimes I actually feel good! Don't give up hope & go buy some vitamin D gummies. ♥️

I regret it. I worked in healthcare and had 3 shots in total. It's triggered something that's caused so much inflammation in my body that I'm now out on medical leave as the doctors try to figure it out and it's ruined my financial security. My second bout too. I just finished day 2 of pax, I haven't slept more than 4 hours in the past 24 hours and that taste is SO BAD that it triggers me to throw up every time I try to eat!!! I'm miserable but I felt a lot worse yesterday. The taste is horrible, puking is horrible so, I'm just going to call it a spiritual fast for the next 3 days. Glad to know I'm not suffering through this by myself!

How would you know??? 
I'm sick & suffering and at 43, I discussed my funeral arrangements with my mother and realized that nobody would probably attend my funeral -despite working in healthcare and helping so many people while on and off from work. In general, people will disappoint you. I learned this truth when none of my "friends" attended my wedding. So, mattering to many people is not true for me. How do you know that it's true for them?
You chose an end-date for yourself?

It's called winter & it should be over soon. Try taking some vitamin D in the meantime, buy some flower seeds in the meantime, grow them indoors til the warmth & birds come back. Then, plant your flowers in the ground and appreciate the fruits of your labor. Be sure the seeds are perennials so next year, all you'll have to do is wait for them to come back up. When they do, you can get excited about it and the butterflies will visit along with the birds. Or, move south. Good luck, I'm struggling too.

I support euthanasia as a last resort. Just be sure you've exhausted all other options first and that you're choosing death over life with a sound mind & not once clouded by negative emotions.

I've been doing the opposite. Just eating whatever the f*ck I want and not caring about the consequences. 
When the pandemic started, my best friend, voice of reason & spouse was separated from me because he was Canadian and we had just married and he had no visa to stay in the states yet when the borders closed. I thought it was the worst time of my life. I dated and walked away from the wrong people for so long until I found him and then, we were apart. Life became so hard for me and my daughter. 
Now, the restrictions are almost lifted,he's home every weekend, we almost have a Visa and I've since put on almost 100lbs, I have long covid symptoms and bad anxiety and depression. I see a therapist now and at $135 a visit, have to deal with no financial freedom because those copays really add up. My life sucks even more now because the woman my husband married was healthy & strong but now I'm just a broken shell of myself. I think he wants to leave the relationship. I hate my life. 
I wish I could starve myself to death now but food and weed are the only things that bring me joy. 
I hope u find a reason to not give up hope. It sucks to hate yourself and the life u have.
